Actress Nusrat Bharucha Recovers After Spinal Surgery

Actress Nusrat Bharucha has shared a video showing her condition after undergoing spinal surgery. The video depicts her in a hospital bed with multiple IV drips attached to her hand, while a nurse is seen feeding her. This marks her first public appearance since the surgery.
